gotchas_discovered.issue: Django developers often use null=True on CharField, which is considered an anti-pattern
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Document explicitly with DJ001 Ruff rule and provide correct pattern (empty string default)

gotchas_discovered.issue: Developers may use type: ignore comments too liberally to suppress type checking
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Guidelines recommend using only in specific cases with explanatory comments

gotchas_discovered.issue: Raw SQL queries vulnerable to injection if not properly parameterized
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Bandit B601 rule documented with examples showing parameterized vs ORM approaches

gotchas_discovered.issue: 5-tier import ordering system could be confusing without clear examples
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Document provides explicit examples and mentions isort/Ruff automation

key_decisions: Portuguese language chosen (Brazilian Portuguese) - aligns with project locale
Structured with table of contents for navigation
